# Archive test fixtures

These binary fixtures are copied unchanged from the SharpCompress test archive corpus at tag `0.50.4` (commit `c083c6efd843a844b0c8f7878787360e815be781`).

Upstream source: <https://github.com/adamhathcock/sharpcompress/tree/0.50.4/tests/TestArchives/Archives>

SharpCompress is licensed under the MIT License. The fixtures are used only by focused compatibility and security regression tests. SHA-256 hashes are recorded in this directory's `SHA256SUMS` file so accidental fixture changes are detectable.
